title: winners-curse-template-fits: selection reuse in machine-learned template fits
description: Code, stored results and figure scripts for R. Wang, 'The winner's curse in machine-learned template fits: selection bias from reusing finite simulated samples and how to avoid it' (submitted to Computer Physics Communications). Includes a vectorised profile-likelihood fitter with exact treatment of finite simulation statistics, the workflows and matched controls of the study, calibration procedures, tests and a performance benchmark.
